objective: Descomponer exclusivamente Q06D de Gate12N campo por campo en READ_ONLY_SQL para localizar la causa exacta del FAIL. No volver a ejecutar Q06A-Q06C y no iniciar UAT. Verificar tipos y valores de CavaSocios_Socios.EmpresaID, Estatus, Activo, PersonaID; comprobar compatibilidad de tipo y dominio con Sistema_Empresas.EmpresaID y Unidades_Negocio.id; validar cada predicado por separado y finalmente GROUP BY/HAVING sin forzar conversiones peligrosas. No modificar datos, codigo, permisos, menus, roles, usuarios, unidades ni Produccion.

queries.name: Q06D01_cava_column_types
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND c.name IN (N'EmpresaID',N'Estatus',N'Activo',N'PersonaID',N'SocioID') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: Q06D02_empresa_domain_types
queries.sql: SELECT N'Sistema_Empresas.EmpresaID' AS field_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Sistema_Empresas') AND c.name=N'EmpresaID' UNION ALL SELECT N'Unidades_Negocio.id',TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id),c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Unidades_Negocio') AND c.name=N'id';

queries.name: Q06D03_cava_sample_identity_values
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(100),EmpresaID) AS EmpresaID_Text,Estatus,Activo,CONVERT(varchar(100),PersonaID) AS PersonaID_Text FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios ORDER BY FechaCreacion,SocioID;

queries.name: Q06D04_predicate_activo_only
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN Activo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activo_1,SUM(CASE WHEN Activo=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activo_0,SUM(CASE WHEN Activo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activo_null FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: Q06D05_predicate_estatus_only
queries.sql: SELECT Estatus,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios GROUP BY Estatus ORDER BY Estatus;

queries.name: Q06D06_predicate_persona_only
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS persona_null,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS persona_not_null FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: Q06D07_cava_empresa_matches_unit_uuid
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS matched_rows FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios cs INNER JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio un ON TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,cs.EmpresaID)=un.id;

queries.name: Q06D08_cava_empresa_matches_empresa_int_safely
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS matched_rows FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios cs INNER JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas se ON TRY_CONVERT(int,CONVERT(varchar(100),cs.EmpresaID))=se.EmpresaID;

queries.name: Q06D09_groupby_having_native_cava_domain
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(100),EmpresaID) AS CavaEmpresaID,COUNT_BIG(SocioID) AS socios_activos,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_sin_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE Activo=1 AND Estatus=N'ACTIVO' GROUP BY EmpresaID HAVING COUNT_BIG(SocioID)>0 ORDER BY CavaEmpresaID;

queries.name: Q06D10_candidate_unit_uuid_join_without_group
queries.sql: WITH E AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.UsuarioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),u.PublicUUID) AS PublicUUID,u.Email,u.NombreCompleto,urc.UnidadNegocioID,UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.CodigoAccion))) AS CodigoAccion FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo u INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto urc ON urc.UsuarioID=u.UsuarioID AND urc.Activo=1 INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm ON prm.RolID=urc.RolID AND prm.Activo=1 AND prm.Permitido=1 INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m ON m.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID AND ISNULL(m.Activo,1)=1 INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID AND ISNULL(a.Activo,1)=1 WHERE u.Activo=1 AND u.PublicUUID IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.CodigoModulo)))=N'cava_socios' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.CodigoAccion))) IN (N'VER',N'EDITAR')), Eligible AS (SELECT UsuarioID,PublicUUID,Email,NombreCompleto,UnidadNegocioID FROM E GROUP BY UsuarioID,PublicUUID,Email,NombreCompleto,UnidadNegocioID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN CodigoAccion=N'VER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN CodigoAccion=N'EDITAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1) SELECT e.UsuarioID,e.Email,CONVERT(varchar(100),e.UnidadNegocioID) AS UnidadNegocioID,un.codigo AS UnidadCodigo,CONVERT(varchar(100),cs.EmpresaID) AS CavaEmpresaID,CONVERT(varchar(36),cs.SocioID) AS SocioID,cs.Estatus,cs.Activo,CONVERT(varchar(100),cs.PersonaID) AS PersonaID FROM Eligible e INNER JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio un ON un.id=e.UnidadNegocioID LEFT JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Socios cs ON TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,cs.EmpresaID)=e.UnidadNegocioID ORDER BY e.Email,un.codigo,cs.SocioID;

constraints: Do not rerun Q06A Q06B or Q06C
No permission menu role user unit or company changes
Do not assume EmpresaID domains are compatible
Use safe TRY_CONVERT for diagnostic comparisons only
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains source of truth
